cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Close It Properly
cards.instruction: Keep them present until both of you complete the ritual that formally ends this role, meeting, or relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Before you hand in your shop keys, we do the farewell bell.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm leaving because the bell rings constantly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Precisely. This is the last one you have to answer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We ring it together. Leaving is still a team activity.

confusable: D170 holds for a mutual formal ending; D169 recruits ongoing responsibility rather than ending it.
comparison: Voluntary club closure versus ending a shop job after bell fatigue.
seedUse: Keep B agreement as the cause of joint ringing, but remove the explanatory team-activity slogan.
